package cardrpg

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	attr "example.com/card-rpg-practice/game/gameplay/attribute"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/gameplay/skill/combat"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
)

type Unit struct {
	HP, MaxHP, Attack, Armor, Speed, Mana, Shield, Poison int64
	Power                                                 int64
}
type TurnCommand struct {
	Seq     uint64
	ActorID int64
	Kind    string
	Target  int
}
type TurnLog struct {
	Command TurnCommand
	At      int64
}
type BattleState struct {
	Units               [6]Unit
	Order               [6]int
	Cursor, Round, Wave int
	RNG                 uint64
	Status              string
	Deadline            int64
	Actions             int
}
type Battle struct {
	Schema         int
	OwnerID, RunID int64
	AdmissionSeq   uint64
	Stage          int
	Rules          Rules
	ConfigHash     string
	Initial        [6]Unit
	InitialSeed    uint64
	StartedAt      int64
	State          BattleState
	Log            []TurnLog
	Claimed        bool
}

func (p Profile) TeamUnits(r Rules) ([6]Unit, error) {
	var units [6]Unit
	if !p.validTeam(p.Team) || r.Validate() != nil {
		return units, ErrRule
	}
	for i, id := range p.Team {
		c := p.card(id)
		base := r.Heroes[c.Template-1]
		profile := &attr.HeroStats{}
		profile.SetHP(base.HP + c.Level*10 + c.Stars*5)
		profile.SetAttack(base.Attack + c.Level*2 + c.Stars*3 + c.Gear*4)
		profile.SetArmor(base.Armor + c.Gear*2)
		profile.SetSpeed(base.Speed)
		profile.Update()
		units[i] = Unit{HP: profile.HP, MaxHP: profile.HP, Attack: profile.Attack, Armor: profile.Armor, Speed: profile.Speed, Mana: 3, Power: profile.Power}
	}
	return units, nil
}
func NewBattle(ownerID, runID int64, seq uint64, stage int, r Rules, initial [6]Unit, seed uint64, now int64) (Battle, error) {
	if ownerID <= 0 || runID <= 0 || seq == 0 || stage < 1 || stage > 3 || r.Validate() != nil || seed == 0 || !ValidTime(now) {
		return Battle{}, ErrRule
	}
	b := Battle{Schema: 1, OwnerID: ownerID, RunID: runID, AdmissionSeq: seq, Stage: stage, Rules: r, ConfigHash: r.Hash(), Initial: initial, InitialSeed: seed, StartedAt: now}
	for _, u := range initial[:3] {
		if u.HP != u.MaxHP || u.HP < 1 || u.HP > 2000 || u.Attack < 1 || u.Attack > 200 || u.Armor < 0 || u.Armor > 200 || u.Speed < 1 || u.Speed > 100 || u.Mana != 3 || u.Poison != 0 || u.Shield != 0 {
			return Battle{}, ErrRule
		}
	}
	b.State = BattleState{Units: initial, RNG: seed, Status: "running", Wave: 1, Round: 1, Deadline: now + TurnMillis}
	b.spawn()
	b.order()
	return b, nil
}
func (b *Battle) spawn() {
	s := b.Rules.Stages[b.Stage-1]
	for i := 3; i < 6; i++ {
		b.State.Units[i] = Unit{HP: s.HP, MaxHP: s.HP, Attack: s.Attack, Armor: 2, Speed: int64(10 - i), Mana: 3}
	}
}
func (b *Battle) order() {
	for i := range b.State.Order {
		b.State.Order[i] = i
	}
	sort.SliceStable(b.State.Order[:], func(i, j int) bool {
		return b.State.Units[b.State.Order[i]].Speed > b.State.Units[b.State.Order[j]].Speed
	})
	b.State.Cursor = 0
	for b.State.Units[b.State.Order[b.State.Cursor]].HP == 0 {
		b.State.Cursor++
	}
}
func (b Battle) CurrentActor() int {
	if b.State.Status != "running" {
		return -1
	}
	return b.State.Order[b.State.Cursor]
}
func (b Battle) NextSeq() uint64 { return uint64(len(b.Log)) + 1 }
func (b Battle) Encode() string  { return encode(b) }
func (b Battle) Digest() string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(b.Encode()))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func DecodeBattle(raw string) (Battle, error) {
	var b Battle
	if err := StrictJSON(raw, &b); err != nil {
		return b, err
	}
	if b.Schema != 1 || b.ConfigHash != b.Rules.Hash() || len(b.Log) > MaxActions {
		return b, ErrRule
	}
	replay, err := NewBattle(b.OwnerID, b.RunID, b.AdmissionSeq, b.Stage, b.Rules, b.Initial, b.InitialSeed, b.StartedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return b, err
	}
	for _, log := range b.Log {
		if err := replay.step(log.Command, log.At); err != nil {
			return b, err
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(replay.State, b.State) || b.Claimed && b.State.Status == "running" {
		return b, ErrRule
	}
	return b, nil
}

// Apply 以事务局部副本执行；序号和业务命令是永久身份，重放不重复 RNG / 伤害，服务器时间不属于客户端身份。
func (b *Battle) Apply(c TurnCommand, now int64) error {
	if c.Seq == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq < b.NextSeq() {
		if b.Log[c.Seq-1].Command == c {
			return nil
		}
		return ErrRule
	}
	return b.step(c, now)
}
func (b *Battle) automatic(actor int) (string, int) {
	side := actor / 3
	if b.State.Units[actor].Mana >= 2 {
		for i := side * 3; i < side*3+3; i++ {
			u := b.State.Units[i]
			if u.HP > 0 && u.HP < u.MaxHP/2 {
				return "heal", i
			}
		}
	}
	target := 0
	if side == 0 {
		target = 3
	}
	for b.State.Units[target].HP == 0 {
		target++
	}
	if b.State.Units[actor].Mana >= 3 {
		return "burst", target
	}
	return "attack", target
}
func (b *Battle) step(c TurnCommand, now int64) error {
	if b.State.Status != "running" || c.Seq != b.NextSeq() || len(b.Log) >= MaxActions || !ValidTime(now) || now < b.StartedAt || len(b.Log) > 0 && now < b.Log[len(b.Log)-1].At {
		return ErrRule
	}
	actor := b.CurrentActor()
	kind, target := c.Kind, c.Target
	if c.ActorID == b.OwnerID {
		if kind == "retreat" {
			if target != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			b.State.Status = "retreated"
			b.Log = append(b.Log, TurnLog{c, now})
			b.State.Actions++
			return nil
		}
		if actor >= 3 || now >= b.State.Deadline {
			return ErrRule
		}
		if kind == "auto" {
			if target != 0 {
				return ErrRule
			}
			kind, target = b.automatic(actor)
		}
	} else if c.ActorID == 0 {
		if target != 0 || kind != "enemy" && kind != "timeout" || kind == "enemy" && actor < 3 || kind == "timeout" && now < b.State.Deadline {
			return ErrRule
		}
		kind, target = b.automatic(actor)
	} else {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if target < 0 || target >= 6 || b.State.Units[target].HP == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	source := &b.State.Units[actor]
	victim := &b.State.Units[target]
	switch kind {
	case "attack", "burst":
		if actor/3 == target/3 || kind == "burst" && source.Mana < 3 {
			return ErrRule
		}
	case "heal":
		if actor/3 != target/3 || source.Mana < 2 {
			return ErrRule
		}
	case "guard":
		if target != actor {
			return ErrRule
		}
	default:
		return ErrRule
	}
	if source.Poison > 0 {
		source.HP = max(int64(0), source.HP-3)
		source.Poison--
	}
	if source.HP > 0 {
		switch kind {
		case "guard":
			source.Shield = min(int64(30), source.Shield+15)
		case "heal":
			source.Mana -= 2
			victim.HP = min(victim.MaxHP, victim.HP+18)
		case "attack", "burst":
			amount := source.Attack
			if kind == "burst" {
				source.Mana -= 3
				amount = amount * 3 / 2
			} else {
				source.Mana = min(int64(5), source.Mana+1)
			}
			b.State.RNG ^= b.State.RNG << 13
			b.State.RNG ^= b.State.RNG >> 7
			b.State.RNG ^= b.State.RNG << 17
			src := combat.Combatant{Alive: true, Health: source.HP, MaxHealth: source.MaxHP, ForceCritical: b.State.RNG%5 == 0}
			dst := combat.Combatant{Alive: true, Health: victim.HP, MaxHealth: victim.MaxHP, Shield: victim.Shield, Armor: victim.Armor}
			if _, ok := combat.ResolveDamage(&src, &dst, combat.DamageInput{Amount: amount, Type: combat.DamageTypePhysical, CanCritical: true}, nil); !ok {
				return ErrRule
			}
			victim.HP = dst.Health
			victim.Shield = dst.Shield
			if kind == "burst" && victim.HP > 0 {
				victim.Poison = 2
			}
		}
	}
	b.Log = append(b.Log, TurnLog{c, now})
	b.State.Actions++
	alive := [2]int{}
	for i, u := range b.State.Units {
		if u.HP > 0 {
			alive[i/3]++
		}
	}
	switch {
	case alive[0] == 0:
		b.State.Status = "lost"
	case alive[1] == 0:
		if b.State.Wave == b.Rules.Stages[b.Stage-1].Waves {
			b.State.Status = "won"
		} else {
			b.State.Wave++
			b.State.Round++
			b.spawn()
			b.order()
		}
	}
	if b.State.Status == "running" && b.State.Actions >= MaxActions {
		b.State.Status = "lost"
	}
	if b.State.Status == "running" {
		if alive[1] != 0 {
			for {
				b.State.Cursor++
				if b.State.Cursor >= 6 {
					b.State.Round++
					b.order()
					break
				}
				if b.State.Units[b.State.Order[b.State.Cursor]].HP > 0 {
					break
				}
			}
		}
		b.State.Deadline = now + TurnMillis
	}
	return nil
}
func (b Battle) Stars() int {
	if b.State.Status != "won" {
		return 0
	}
	stars := 3
	for _, u := range b.State.Units[:3] {
		if u.HP == 0 {
			stars = 1
		}
	}
	if b.State.Actions > 40 {
		stars = min(stars, 2)
	}
	return stars
}

type BattleView struct {
	RunID                     int64
	Stage, Wave, Round, Actor int
	NextSeq                   uint64
	Deadline                  int64
	Units                     [6]Unit
	Status                    string
	Claimed                   bool
}

func (b Battle) View() BattleView {
	return BattleView{b.RunID, b.Stage, b.State.Wave, b.State.Round, b.CurrentActor(), b.NextSeq(), b.State.Deadline, b.State.Units, b.State.Status, b.Claimed}
}
